title: New colors resource pack
description: This resource pack, changes the color of many thing in minecraft, like the color of grass, the sun, the moon, the hearts, and alot more!
body: Changes the colors of alot of things, like endermen being blue, the grass having brand new colors based on the colored of the nether, the moon is red, the sun is blue, the hearts are blue, hardcore hearts are end colored, the font is blue, the title text has nether colors, and the "java edition" is blue.
